abstract: Alpha-fetoprotein was assayed radioimmunologically in 51 samples of sera from 26 patients who had been operated for embryonal cell carcinoma of the testis. The test was found to have good prognostic value. Elevated levels were seen frequently in patients with metastase or who developed metastases. The kinetic study of alpha-fetoprotein allows us to monitor treatment efficiency, as well as to study cancer evolution.
abstract_ja: 外科的治療を受けた精巣胎児性癌患者26例の血清51検体について、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を放射免疫測定法で測定した。AFP検査は良好な予後的価値を有していた。転移を有する患者や後に転移を来した患者では高値がしばしば認められた。AFPの経時的動態から治療効果を評価でき、癌の進展を検討することも可能であった。
